code: if(!window.state.jungleBg||window.state.jungleBg.width!==width){let g=createGraphics(width,height);g.colorMode(HSB,360,100,100,100);g.noStroke();let hz=height*0.46;for(let y=0;y<hz;y++){let t=y/hz;g.fill(30-t*10,70,25+t*30);g.rect(0,y,width,1);}g.fill(35,60,80,40);g.ellipse(width*0.5,hz*0.7,hz*1.2,hz*1.2);for(let L=0;L<4;L++){let base=hz*(0.2+L*0.18),hue=100+L*15,sat=60+L*8,bri=25+L*12;g.fill(hue,sat,bri);for(let x=-40;x<width+40;x+=70){g.push();g.translate(x+((L*30)),base);g.rotate(Math.sin(x*0.01+L)*0.3);g.ellipse(0,0,120,80);g.pop();}}g.stroke(90,70,20);g.strokeWeight(4);g.noFill();for(let v=0;v<8;v++){let vx=(v*137)%width;g.beginShape();for(let y=0;y<hz;y+=20){g.vertex(vx+Math.sin(y*0.03+v)*20,y);}g.endShape();}g.noStroke();g.push();g.blendMode(ADD);for(let i=0;i<50;i++){let x=(i*151)%width,y=(i*97)%hz;g.fill(65,80,100,25);g.ellipse(x,y,4,4);}g.pop();g.fill(90,60,12);g.rect(0,hz,width,height-hz);window.state.jungleBg=g;}image(window.state.jungleBg,0,0);
